comment: PLAN-127 — final spec for the R-357 frame set v5 (oracle scripts/build-panel-frame5-assets.py, golden mockup-r357-cornici-aperta.png sliced directly, case a of PLAN-127 §3.2). Minimal style: source.key carries the colour-class key once; corner|ornament inherit it and add despeckle+borderSoften (the oracle's keyart chain); edges opt out with key:{type:none} and emit opaque wrapBlend tiles. Evidence: night-shift 2026-11-19 (frame5-minimal/full findings, anti-DSL >=2-surface gate in SUMMARY.md). Render-side fields (displaySize/pos/span/variants/geometry.backings) added 2026-11-19 for the manifest-consumption path (OB-2): they reproduce EXACTLY the hand-tuned geometry PanelFrameOrnaments cornici/corniciStash ships today — evidence = the 2 real surfaces that consume it (Roster + Stash panels).

classes.comment: gem — g - max(r,b) - 8 (emerald needs stronger green)

key.comment: oracle keyart(): keep = max(brass, gem-8); alpha = clip((keep-6)*18). Keys warm metal + emerald on the painted map/plaque ground where no flat sampleRect exists. corner|ornament only — edges opt out below.

backings.comment: corner-bite backings: the plaque's rounded corner arc leaves a crescent of backdrop between the bands' inner rims — a patch whose own rounded edge follows the plaque arc covers the wedge (PanelFrameOrnaments contract; roster + stash share it)

geometry.comment: outerRect = frame art bbox on the golden; contentRect = interior inside the inner filets (inferred in panel-frame5-full.json from the oracle docstring: left spine x15-49, top band y108-147, right wire x331-338, bottom wire y449-453). NOT the golden's roster panel box (x14-340 y108-453): runtime placement is per-piece pos/span — authored data, not derived from these rects.

slices.comment: acanthus+gem knuckle; displaySize/pos = PanelFrameOrnaments CORNER_PX.tl + authored offset (knuckle mass centred on the panel corner, not derivable from any hole rect)
gem stud — hand-tuned NON-UNIFORM scale (native 34x32 → 22x20): why displaySize, not displayScale
engraved vine band; displayScale derives displaySize [112,30] — rim side derived: top = -(30 - rimOverlapPx) = -29
engraved lattice spine; asymmetric span (-24 top under the knuckle, -12 bottom over the stud)
R-357 golden: chest clasp seats ON the stash's top wire — pos.left '16%' reproduces PanelFrameOrnaments verbatim; roster variant ('cornici') filters it out via variants
